subject: POC Sprint Kickoff + Hands-on Prompt Lab — scheduling and prep
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlashealth.com>, Lydia Cho <lydia@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Sprint Kickoff + Hands-on Prompt Lab — initial scheduling

Hi Samir / Lydia,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a short POC with Redwood. We want to kick off with a 90-minute hands-on session that combines: a brief product walkthrough (20 min), a prompt inventory & guardrails review (30–35 min), and a short routing/load-test window (25–30 min) to validate throughput and latency under your typical payloads.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Jun 23, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 24, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Jun 25, 09:00–10:30

Can you confirm which of the above works, and whether you prefer the session recorded? Also cc'ing Marissa (solutions) and Ben (infra) who will run the load test portion.

Quick logistics: please share a short sample of your prompt inventory (or allow us to use the attached template) and any structured output requirements (JSON schema / field constraints). We'll bring a short loadtest window proposal for your sign-off.

Attachments: prompt-inventory-template.csv

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Samir Patel <samir@atlashealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Cho <lydia@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC Sprint Kickoff + Hands-on Prompt Lab — initial scheduling

Stephanie —

Thanks, this looks good. Wed Jun 24 14:00 PDT should work for our clinical team and product folks. We do have one constraint: our procurement lead (procurement@atlashealth.com) needs a heads-up about any load tests that might look like synthetic traffic; they prefer a short notice window.

Can you loop procurement into the final invite and include expected duration and an IP range for the load tests? Also, we need the session to produce a JSON schema for structured outputs — will your team draft an initial schema based on the sample prompts?

Regards,
Samir
Director of Product, AtlasHealth
samir@atlashealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlashealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Sprint Kickoff + Hands-on Prompt Lab — agenda + artifacts

Thanks Samir — Wed Jun 24 14:00 PDT is on our end as well. Quick notes and asks from the Redwood side: 

Agenda (90 min):
- 14:00–14:10: Quick intros & success criteria
- 14:10–14:30: Demo of Redwood routing and failover (Stephanie)
- 14:30–15:05: Prompt inventory review, guardrails, structured output requirements (group)
- 15:05–15:25: Load-test window & routing validation (Ben)
- 15:25–15:30: Next steps & owners

We will draft an initial JSON schema from the sample prompts you provide and circulate it pre-read. Attached is the prompt-inventory-template.csv — please fill with 10–15 representative prompts if possible.

For the load test: Ben, please see the proposed window file. We'll keep the synthetic traffic rate to a maximum of 50 requests/sec in short bursts and share the originating IPs in the invite. Procurement: if you prefer a short SLA or a self-serve kill-switch, we can include both in the plan.

Attachments: loadtest-window-proposal.md, prompt-inventory-template.csv

Action items for AtlasHealth before the session:
- Share sample prompt inventory (file or populate template)
- Confirm whether session may be recorded
- Any existing JSON response schema or sample outputs to reuse

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@atlashealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com, Lydia Cho <lydia@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC Sprint Kickoff + Hands-on Prompt Lab — agenda + artifacts

Marissa/Stephanie —

Quick update: I'm traveling on Wed and won't be available for a 14:00 PDT slot. Apologies — can we move to Thu Jun 25 09:00 PDT? That would give our clinical lead (Lydia) time to compile the sample prompts.

Procurement is OK with the proposed load-test cap if you share an IP list and kill-switch procedures. They asked that the load-test window be scheduled during business hours and not exceed 30 minutes.

I'll share the prompt inventory by EOD Wednesday (22 Jun) and a brief note on structured outputs.

Thanks,
Samir

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlashealth.com>, Lydia Cho <lydia@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Sprint Kickoff + Hands-on Prompt Lab — final invite + prework

Thanks for the update, Samir — Thu Jun 25 09:00–10:30 PDT is confirmed. I've created the calendar invite and included the IPs for the short load-test window and a kill-switch contact. Recording is turned off by default; we will only record with your written OK.

Prework for AtlasHealth (deliver by EOD Wed Jun 24):
- Prompt inventory (use attached template) — filename: atlas-prompt-sample.csv
- Any existing JSON schema or example outputs
- Names/emails of all attendees and any SSO/trust contacts we should whitelabel

Redwood will deliver by Thu morning:
- Draft JSON schema from your samples
- Final loadtest plan (max 30 minutes, IPs and kill-switch)
- Short pre-read: demo bullets and guardrail checklist (link below)

Links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-poc-kickoff-atlashealth | https://docs.google.com/document/d/handson-agenda | HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/atlashealth

Action owners:
- AtlasHealth: prompt inventory + attendees — Samir/Lydia
- Redwood: schema + loadtest plan — Marissa/Ben/Stephanie

See you Thursday,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

[Attachments: prompt-inventory-template.csv, loadtest-window-proposal.md]
